headline: Premier League: City lead by three into Matchweek 7 chase
whyCareReason: Manchester City sit top on 18 points (6-0-0) after the 3-0 at Anfield. Arsenal trail by three. Matchweek 7 begins Saturday.
teaser: Coventry beat Newcastle 4-1 on Monday. City lead with 18 points, Arsenal 15, Brighton 13, Liverpool 9. Tottenham sit 19th on 3 points.
story: The Premier League table stands with Manchester City on a perfect 18 points from six wins, scoring 16 goals and conceding 5. Arsenal are second with 15 points (5-0-1), and Brighton are third with 13 points (4-1-1). Matchweek 6 concluded on Monday night when Coventry City defeated Newcastle United 4-1 at the Coventry Building Society Arena with goals from Jack Rudoni (penalty), Sidiki Cherif, Sven Botman, Ellis Simms, and Stephen Mfuni. Frank Lampard's Coventry climbed to 14th on 6 points, level with Manchester United, while Newcastle remained 11th on 8. Domestic football returns on Saturday 17 October for Matchweek 7. This desk does not invent scores for unplayed matches.
stakes: City hold a three-point cushion over Arsenal. Liverpool are ninth on 9 points, level with Leeds and Hull. Tottenham sit 19th in the relegation zone with 3 points.
rivalryAngle: The title race tightens between City and Arsenal ahead of a packed weekend schedule.
funFacts: Table top: Manchester City 18 pts (6-0-0, 16 GF, 5 GA), Arsenal 15 pts (5-0-1), Brighton 13 pts (4-1-1).
Monday finish: Coventry City 4-1 Newcastle United. Rudoni 6 pen, Cherif 48, Botman 70, Simms 81, Mfuni 86.
Matchweek 7 fixtures resume Saturday 17 October 2026 across England.
